# anthropic_user (Resource)

Adopts a member of the organization through the Admin API and manages
the member's organization role.

The Admin API cannot add a member directly, so this resource is import-only: invite the
person with `anthropic_invite` or add them in the organization settings, then run
`terraform import anthropic_user.<name> user_...` to bring the member under
management. A plain `resource "anthropic_user"` block applied without an import
fails, because there is nothing to create.

Destroying this resource only stops managing the member and leaves them in the
organization with their current role. Removing a member cannot be undone and
this resource did not add them, so Delete never calls the API.

Needs `read:members` and `write:members` on a Claude Enterprise key, plus
`write:rbac_groups` to set the `managed` role.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "anthropic_users" "jane" {
  email = "jane@example.com"
}

resource "anthropic_user" "jane" {
  role = "managed"
}

import {
  to = anthropic_user.jane
  id = data.anthropic_users.jane.users[0].id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `role` (String) Organization role of the member. The API decides which roles it can assign. A Claude Console organization accepts `user`, `developer`, `billing` and `claude_code_user`; `admin` cannot be assigned through the API. A Claude Enterprise organization accepts `user` and `managed`, and rejects a change to a member who holds `owner`, `membership_admin` or `primary_owner`, or whose role the identity provider manages.

### Read-Only

- `added_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp of when the member joined the organization.
- `email` (String) Email of the member.
- `id` (String) The unique ID of this resource.
- `name` (String) Name of the member.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import anthropic_user.jane user_01AbCdEfGhIjKlMnOpQrSt
```
